<b>Silkeaters</b> are [[Items (Silksong)#Consumables|consumable items]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are mostly found in places with plentiful [[Silk]], recognisable by their white cocoons.

== Use ==
Silkeaters may be consumed from the inventory to immediately retrieve Hornet's [[Cocoon]], regardless of where it is in the world. If a Silkeater is consumed while no Cocoon exists, it does nothing.

{{Steel Soul Icon Mini|SS}} In [[Steel Soul Mode (Silksong)|Steel Soul Mode]], Silkeaters can be sold to [[Skynx]] for {{R|46–154}}.<ref group="Note">Skynx gives either {{R|50}}, {{R|100}}, or {{R|150}}, with a variation of up to {{R|4}}.</ref>

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Skynx.png!{{Steel Soul Icon Mini|SS}} Location in Sinner's Road
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Skynx 02.png!Skynx in Sinner's Road
}}

== How to Acquire ==
Silkeaters are grown by [[Styx]] in [[Sinner's Road]], at a rate of one every hour. He will hold one Silkeater at a time in his nest until the <i>[[Queen's Egg (Wish)|Queen's Egg]]</i> [[wish]] is completed, after which he will hold up to two Silkeaters. Styx is not available in {{Steel Soul Icon Mini|SS}} [[Steel Soul Mode (Silksong)|Steel Soul Mode]].

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Styx.png!Location in Sinner's Road
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Sinner's Road 08.png!Styx in Sinner's Road
}}

Silkeaters are also found by breaking their cocoons in various locations across [[Pharloom]].

== Trivia ==
* Silkeater cocoons occasionally pulse, similarly to [[Grand Mother Silk]]'s cocoon and [[Silk Heart]]s.
* Young Silkeater cocoons are usually found close to fully formed cocoons throughout Pharloom. Just like on the Styx's farm, striking them does not produce a Silkeater, only a bar or two of Silk.
* There is an [[Cut Content (Silksong)/Graphics#Sprites|unused]] animation of Silkeater singing. Hornet cannot access her inventory while playing the [[Needolin]], so it is unknown how it would have appeared.
